prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 replaces the ad-hoc header check with a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that splits the Accept header into entries, normalizes whitespace/case, honors the q=0 (explicitly disabled) quality parameter, and matches type/subtype including wildcards (*/*). #2046 instead swaps the two required substrings for a single acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') check, which does not parse quality values (a client sending 'application/json;q=0' would still be accepted) and is vulnerable to substring false positives since includes() ignores token boundaries. #1996 handles strictly more of the Accept-header grammar correctly than #2046, making it the stronger fix to keep.
